dashboard.label: Reporting périodique MCO & CIM
dashboard.description: Agrégats quotidiens et hebdomadaires sans données événementielles, identités techniques ni secrets.

div.span: PILOTAGE DE SERVICE / QUALITÉ DES DONNÉES
div.p: Une mesure fermée par période, un schéma stable et des tendances affichées uniquement lorsque l'historique est suffisant.

search.query: | inputlookup mco_cim_periodic_history | search report_family="mco_daily" | stats dc(period_start) as value
| inputlookup mco_cim_periodic_history | search report_family="cim_weekly" | stats dc(period_start) as value

single.title: État de l'historique

search.query: | inputlookup mco_cim_periodic_history | stats dc(eval(if(report_family="mco_daily",period_start,null()))) as mco_periods dc(eval(if(report_family="cim_weekly",period_start,null()))) as cim_periods | eval value=if(mco_periods>=2 AND cim_periods>=2,"TENDANCE DISPONIBLE","BASELINE SEULEMENT") | fields value

single.option: AUCUNE EXTRAPOLATION SUR UN POINT UNIQUE

search.query: | inputlookup mco_cim_periodic_history | search report_family="mco_daily" | eventstats max(period_start) as latest_period | where period_start=latest_period | eval periode=strftime(period_start,"%Y-%m-%d"), valeur=round(metric_value,2) | rename metric_id as metrique metric_unit as unite status as etat sample_state as echantillon | table periode metrique valeur unite etat echantillon | sort metrique

| inputlookup mco_cim_periodic_history | search report_family="cim_weekly" | eventstats max(period_start) as latest_period | where period_start=latest_period | eval periode=strftime(period_start,"%Y-%m-%d"), valeur=round(metric_value,2) | rename metric_id as metrique metric_unit as unite status as etat sample_state as echantillon | table periode metrique valeur unite etat echantillon | sort metrique

chart.title: MCO quotidien / taux de succès scheduler

search.query: | inputlookup mco_cim_periodic_history | search report_family="mco_daily" metric_id="scheduler.success_pct" | eventstats dc(period_start) as periods | where periods>=2 | eval _time=period_start | timechart span=1d latest(metric_value) as "Succès scheduler (%)"

chart.title: MCO quotidien / signaux nécessitant une action

search.query: | inputlookup mco_cim_periodic_history | search report_family="mco_daily" (metric_id="ingestion.late_datasets" OR metric_id="scheduler.skipped") | eventstats dc(period_start) as periods | where periods>=2 | eval _time=period_start | timechart span=1d latest(metric_value) by metric_id useother=f usenull=f

| inputlookup mco_cim_periodic_history | search report_family="cim_weekly" metric_id="cim.rows_complete_pct" | eventstats dc(period_start) as periods | where periods>=2 | eval _time=period_start | timechart span=1w latest(metric_value) as "Lignes complètes (%)"

| inputlookup mco_cim_periodic_history | search report_family="cim_weekly" metric_id="cim.field.*.pct" | eventstats dc(period_start) as periods | where periods>=2 | eval _time=period_start | timechart span=1w latest(metric_value) by metric_id limit=10 useother=f usenull=f

| inputlookup mco_cim_periodic_history | stats count as lignes dc(report_key) as clés min(schema_version) as schéma_min max(schema_version) as schéma_max dc(metric_id) as métriques dc(report_family) as familles | eval contrôle=if(lignes=clés AND schéma_min=1 AND schéma_max=1,"CONFORME","À CONTRÔLER") | table contrôle lignes clés familles métriques schéma_min schéma_max
